invariants.expression: (templateProps == null) ? (result == parentProps) : (parentProps == null ? result == templateProps : result != null)
invariants.rationale: If either input is null, returns the non-null one. Else, a new merged JsonValue is returned.

invariants.expression: (templateProps != null && parentProps != null) ? (result != parentProps && result != templateProps) : true
invariants.rationale: A fresh merged JsonValue is returned only when both inputs are non-null.
If both inputs are null, the result is null.
result is not null except when both inputs are null.
Result is either parentProps, templateProps, or a new instance.
